rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold — and for the quick turnaround ask. I'm going to pass on a named quote for this piece; things are still early and I'm not set up to speak on the record yet. Appreciate you reaching out, and good luck with the piece. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined the reporter's (Tessa Brandt) request for a named quote

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad the meetup talk landed, and thank you for offering real hours, not just good wishes. Honest answer: Halcyon Threshold is still taking shape — I'm sorting out a couple of org/employer-disclosure details before I commit to a specific project publicly. I don't want to hand you something vague just to have you \"helping.\" Once I've nailed down the first concrete piece of work (most likely something evals- or measurement-shaped, where your data background would be a big help), I'll come back to you with something real and scoped. If you have a preference between data wrangling, stats/scoring, or something else, let me know and I'll keep it in mind when I shape the first task. Thanks again — talk soon, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent Priya Raman a holding reply — thanked her, said the project shape is still settling, no commitments made.
